notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
Dear users. Today we have released an update to version 2.1. This update combines both gameplay improvements and a partial return to the old atmosphere of the game. We know that not all players liked the visibility markings and the number of weapons. The complete list of changes is as follows:

NEW FEATURES

 Syringes now not only bring a teammate back to life, but also allow you to add protection to a friend during the game
 Monster attack has become more effective
 Added scene after player death
 Crossbow shoots more realistic
 Update of the "How to play" page. It's more understandable now


RETURNING THE OLD ATMOSPHERE

 Removed visibility markers above players' heads
 The level map is now loaded with areas, forcing you to explore the world of the game more
 The crossbow is now better hidden in the level. You can't just get it at the start of the game


REMOVING BUGS

 Improved voice chat

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
Dear users. We have done a great job to improve the game and are glad to present you VERSION 2.0. In this version, you will find many significant changes:


ENEMIES

[olist]
 Now opponents react to player movements based on many parameters: visibility, noise, flashlight, etc.
 Enemies have become more dangerous and learned to deal damage from a distance
 Barricades guarded by cultists appeared on the roads
[/olist]

WEAPON


 A real weapon appeared - a crossbow. Look for it in special boxes on the map


LEVEL


 Created a brand new final cave with a monolith, now much more epic
 Added level map


OTHER


 Reworked lighting and sound systems
 and dozens of other improvements ...



The changes are very significant, they greatly change the atmosphere of the game. And it seems to us that now it will be much more difficult and interesting to play!

We are also making plans for the further development of the project. One of the ideas is to add food gathering in the forest, which will increase the stamina and defense of players. What do you think?

notes.title: Global patch "February 2021"
notes.content:
Good afternoon, our dear players!

We continue to develop the "Sign of Silence" project and release another big patch "February 2021". In this patch you will find global optimization and a number of gameplay improvements


GLOBAL OPTIMIZATION

We have developed a system for streaming objects on the map, similar to that used by large open world games. This allowed us to achieve an increase in FPS by 3-5 times on most video cards. Now "Sign of Silence" will be comfortable to play on medium level hardware


GAMEPLAY


 We have added a "lives" accumulation system. How to get additional "lives" - you will learn in the game!

 In the new version, you can finally see the detective - the one whose notes you found all over the map

 The Witch can now spawn randomly while tracking players. You need to be even more careful when traveling through the forest!


There are also many small improvements to gameplay, textures and sounds awaiting you. We continue to develop the project and will delight you with new additions and improvements. Follow our news!

notes.title: Big update: new location, new enemies
notes.content:
Hello, our players! 
We haven't released updates for a long time, and now, finally, this moment has come!

Today we present you with a big update with new location,   new enemy,   new ending and many other innovations and improvements.

 Game innovations 

 New location 
Added a new location -   Mines with lair of darkness.
The old mines located under Riven Peak are now open to the public. In them you can find new adventures, wander around interesting places and find a lair of darkness - a terrible monolith that is the source of evil in these places.

 New enemy 
  The Cultist is a fanatical minion of the forbidden cult who worships the monolith. He is able to get into the mind and kill anyone he sees. The cultists don't see very well in the dark, but don't get caught in his flashlight.

 New ending 
  Expulsion of darkness. Once they reach the monolith, players can interrupt the cultists' ritual that supports it, killing them and freeing Danville and the surrounding area from the forces of darkness.

 New life after death 
Now, after the witch kills the player, by tearing off the head, the forces of darkness make the head "come to life", turning it into a terrible spider-like creature that can follow its friends, but, unfortunately, it will not be able to escape.

 New achievement 
After completing the game on a new ending, players will receive a new achievement that they can brag to their friends.

 Improved gameplay 

 Added various horror scenes throughout the location

 Bug fixes 

 bug with audio chat looping fixed
 fixed the work of players' marks, now we can see the place where our friends died
 fixed behavior of the witch when players split
 fixed bug of duplicating monsters when changing master client
 other minor bugs fixed


[previewyoutube=s0EKlcppGFE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Optimization and performance
notes.content:
Good afternoon, our dear players!

 Halloween is over  and it's time for us to take off our holiday outfits and clean up the scattered pumpkins.
We hope you have a lot of fun during your Halloween celebration!

But, in addition to ending the Halloween event, this update also introduces what many of you have been waiting for - game optimizations and performance increases! As well as other changes, but first things first.

 Performance improvements 

  a lot of work has been done to optimize the game 
 the system of loading and storing game objects in memory has been reworked
 reduced the total number of game objects by combining them
 simplified polygon of some small objects that do not affect the visual appearance of the game
 configured LOD groups for stones and branches


 Game innovations 

 added a pointer to the north on the compass for better orientation on the map
 increased the number of places where ordinary enemies can appear, added the probability of their appearance
 added small screamer in Danwille


 Improvements and changes in the gameplay 

 changed the operation mode of the voice chat: instead of the "push to talk" mode, now the "enable / disable" voice chat mode is used
 sneak mode has become more useful
 improved appearance of trees at minimum quality settings


 Bug fixes 

  bug with audio chat has been fixed!  It has been redone and should now work for all players, even those who are located far from our game server
 fixed a bug with stamina consumption when the player is standing but holding down the run key
 fixed a bug that did not count escaping on a boat if the player was standing on the very edge of the boat
 changed the spawn points of syringes, fixed the places from which they could not be picked up
 other found bugs fixed



 We continue to work on the game, fix bugs, fix known issues, improve gameplay and add new content to the game
Follow the news and enjoy the game
Your "Sign of Silence" team

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
We are so excited to present you a new themed Halloween update! 
In which the mood of this gloomy but cheerful holiday was carried over to our game world.
Let's tell you more about the new products:

 Halloween Event 
- ominous pumpkins appeared on the map, which can be lit
- some enemies became pumpkin monsters by putting a pumpkin on their heads
- players changed into festive halloween costumes

 New game mechanics 
- added the ability to revive killed friends!
- a new pick-up item has appeared - a syringe, with which you can revive your friends
- the reaction of enemies to a shot from a flare gun has been improved, for some of them the hit is now fatal, and for some it can only anger

 Working with achievements 
- Added a new achievement for collecting 100 pumpkins during the Halloween celebration
- Added a new achievement for killing a pumpkin monster during Halloween celebrations
- now the progress of earning achievements is displayed in the incentive

 Work on optimization and bug fixes 
- added a new item in game settings - visibility range, which affects the number of visible objects and, accordingly, on FPS
- fixed found minor bugs
- edited translation into Thai

[previewyoutube=3b7tSX9Qn2o;full][/previewyoutube]

 We hope you have a lot of fun with us and our pumpkin monsters!
Happy Halloween Celebration!
Your command  Sign of Silence

notes.title: Voice chat
notes.content:
In our next update, we have eliminated many problems and errors, as well as added something long-awaited:

 Added voice chat 
- according to your numerous requests, we have added a built-in voice chat (by default, holding the " V " button to talk)

 Game innovations 
- added a new kind of enemy - female spruter
- a house was opened in the Northern Mines location, which was previously closed

 Improved game interface 
- added the ability to override the keys used for movement (important for those using AZERTY keyboards)
- now you do not need to constantly hold the button in order to sneak. Now she switches modes - always sneak or always walk in full height
- edited character animations

 Performance improvements 
- changed graphics settings for low quality, now the low quality level is more productive
- slight increase in performance at other levels of graphics quality
- we will continue to work on increasing the FPS in future updates ...

 Working with achievements 
- added a new achievement: Detective - collect all entries from Blake's diary
- fixed a bug where the Hero of Danville achievement was not awarded

 Bug fixes 
- fixed a black screen error when starting the game for some players
- fix a bug with a timer in the lobby
- fix a bug with incorrect display of the compass on some screen resolutions
- the texture of the map in the game is no longer blurred at low quality settings
- fixed a rare bug with duplicating items when picking up
- fixing other small bugs and errors


 That's all, enjoy the game!
And don't miss the next update, it will be interesting  😉
 Best wishes, your team  Sign of Silence

notes.title: Compass
notes.content:
We are glad to inform you that we have already released the third package of fixes and changes!
Since we did not inform you about the second one here, we present a general list of all the changes that have appeared:

 The user interface has been improved 
 - added  compass  to help you better navigate 
- added character icons in the game, showing who is alive, who died, and who became offline
- icons of the main achievements and a counter of found notes appeared in the main menu
- added the ability to switch the game to windowed mode and change the resolution in the game menu
- to improve stability, game quality can now be applied only after restarting the game

 Changed lobby settings 
- now each player can invite friends to the lobby, there is no longer a party leader
- when the number of ready players is more than half, the countdown starts before the start of the game
- if all players have pressed the "ready" button, the game automatically starts immediately

 Various bugs fixed 
- fixed a bug with the "depth of field" graphic effect, changed its settings
- edited and improved ragdoll, now after killing players, their bodies behave more realistically
- several minor bugs fixed

 And also added support for  Thai  language 
- Owen helped with the translation - @Mr.Demogorgon (WereWolfTheDark), for which many thanks to him!

 Enjoy your game!
Best wishes, your team  Sign of Silence
